name: daraz-marketplace
description: Monorepo root: backend in server/, frontend in web/. These scripts let a host that builds from the repository root (Render) run the API.

scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install --include=dev && npx prisma generate && DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL_DIRECT" npx prisma migrate deploy --skip-generate && npm run build
scripts.build:web: cd web && npm install && npm run build
